title: MZ Any way to have a conditional event choose between a range of numbers in a variable?

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body:
Just wondering if there's a way to have the conditional event command to pick between a range of numbers in a variable.
1. First a variable picks a random number between 1 and 20.
2. A conditional event then has different outcomes depending on the number. 1 - 10 fails, which is easy enough to implement, simply being lesser or equal to 10.
3. A different outcome would happen between numbers 11 - 15
4. And then another outcome for 15 -20. This one is also easy just being greater or equal to.
I'm having questions about the 3rd step. Do I have to use the approach using a separate conditional event for each number, or is there a procedure in Rpg Maker MZ where you can tell it to apply a condition within a range like this. (If it's 11 to 15, then do this...)

posts.author: JamesRyan
posts.body:
I think you can use the Script option (Page 4) in Conditional Branch, and state your condition there like:
Code:
$gameVariables.value(x) >= 11 && $gameVariables.value(x) <= 15
Which X is the variable ID from the variable you set before

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
a cleaner way is to do make conditions separate or nested.
Code:
// sample 1

if variable x > 0 && variable x <= 10
outcome 1
end

if variable x > 10 && variable x <= 15
outcome 2
end

if variable x > 15
outcome 3
end

// alternate
if variable x < 11
outcome 1
else
if variable x < 15
outcome 2
else
if variable < 20
outcome 3
end
end
end
those are valid ways to use 1 variable.
this is the pure evented way, but you can make it shorter as well,
which require ternary operator to get a sweet 1 liner or under each other
to make it more readable, but also cleaner to write.
but that choice is up to you though.
